verdict.rationale: Durable workflows are a fair question for a serverless/edge hosting platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents generic serverless functions, Blobs storage, and a REST API for 'automating workflows'. None of these is a durable, long-running workflow engine with built-in queues and retries; they are at most building blocks.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy durable, long-running workflows as code without manually wiring queues and retries
